title: Pilot Compass: Beta-to-GA customer readiness and release coordination playbook
creator: Ava Patel
description: Create a repeatable, cross-functional playbook to take customers from pilot/beta through to GA readiness. This ticket coordinates release notes, success criteria, ops handoffs, feedback loops, and GTM milestones for the Pilot Compass initiative. The output is a living checklist, a release notes template tied to customers, and a runbook for handoff to CS/Sales/Support.
acceptance_criteria: Completed cross-functional checklist with owners and SLAs for each step
Release notes template populated and linked to each pilot customer with known variants/flags
Success criteria defined and measurable for first 10 pilot accounts
Telemetry dashboard links and alert thresholds documented
Handoff runbook created and validated in a dry-run with CS and Support
Feedback ingestion loop established with weekly cadence and triage owner
tasks: Draft consolidated kickoff checklist (PM owner) - includes technical, legal, and GTM gates
Lock release-notes template and mapping from PRD to customer-facing notes (PM + Docs)
Coordinate with Eng to freeze runtime and feature flags for pilot cohort (Eng owner)
Design a 3-tier success metric set (adoption, latency/cost, quality regressions) and validate with Research
Create telemetry dashboard slices: per-customer token usage, error rate, tail latency, quality regression signals
Schedule and run a handoff dry-run with CS, Support, and Sales ops
Establish weekly beta review: format, participants, artifacts to bring (logs, prompts, evals)
Publish internal 'customer readiness' Confluence page and link to release notes template

rollout_steps: Week 0: Pre-kickoff validation - confirm pilot customer list and top 3 success metrics
Week 1: Feature/flag freeze and release-notes draft for each pilot cohort
Week 2: Telemetry dashboards live and baseline collected (48-72h of data)
Week 3: Handoff dry-run and CS playbook validation
Week 4: First formal beta review with customers; capture feedback into triage board
Week 6: Evaluate against success criteria, decide GA gating for next batch
Post-GA: Expand RUNBOOK into Dedicated/Private onboarding templates and lessons learned
